about_the_game:
Cosmetics pack for Nubs! Arena that contains 9 exclusive Nubs to play with, 6 costume colors to choose from, and 7 emotes.

Tremble and despair, Nubs, as doom has come to your world! Master Nub-Skull is here and with his army of one-eyed Peepsters he plans to force every Nub to wear weird Nub-Nibbler rat suits. If this seems like a good time to you, please have yourself checked by a qualified professional, because this is a very cringe time for everyone. Except Master Nub-Skull himself, who is into that kind of stuff. 

  • Master Nub-Skull

  • Peepster

  • Nub-Nibblers

In horror of this terrible fashion forced upon Nubkind, time-traveling-Nub NUBX-2525 assembles a team of Nubs selected from history to thwart Master Nub-Skulls plans. He has gathered Nubs from ancient Rome, Feudal Japan and recruited Commando Jack Nub-Puncher from the epic 80s. And somehow, someway he also recruited a Mermaid along the way?! But hey, it’s the best he could find to stop the proliferation of horrible rat suits.

  • NUBX-2525

  • Nubturion & Nubtorian

  • Reefy Rhonda

  • Kunoichi Nub

  • Kitsune Nub

  • Commando Jack Nub-Puncher

This pack includes some exclusive colors to spice up your costumes with:

  • Gothic Black

  • Periodic Red

  • Blu Dabadi

  • Ironic Pink

  • Anxious Purple

  • Disociative Disorder Grey

Additionally, because of its multichronical, multicultural, and multilingual background, the team communicates only using these for emotes:

  • Red Flag

  • Kitsune Laugh

  • Clean Up

  • Skull And Bones

  • Fire

  • Uzi

  • Stars
